description: List or search wrecks designated under the Protection of Wrecks Act 1973 in English waters: name, designation date, restricted area in hectares, position (lat/lon and grid reference) and official link. Diving on or interfering with a designated wreck inside its restricted area without a Historic England licence is an offence, so divers and boat users check here. Source: Historic England National Heritage List for England. Covers designated wrecks only (not all wrecks or military remains); the position is a reference point, not the restricted-area boundary. (cost: 1 credit)

name.description: string, optional, part of the wreck name, e.g. 'Mary Rose' (omit to list all)

name: protected_wreck_search
